title: Getting married
intro: Getting to know each other the Islamic way, engagement, the wedding, the mahr – and divorce.

learn.title: 📖 In the Qur’an
learn.html: Allah (SWT) says: Help those among you who are single to marry… <small>(Qur’an, An-Nur 24:32)</small>
One of the duties of Muslim men and women who are adult, sensible and healthy, and who also have the basic means to live, is to get married.
When a young man and a young woman become interested in each other with the aim of marriage, their duty is:

items: to keep to the Islamic way of meeting and talking,
to get to know each other,
to share their opinions and views,
to talk about the important things in life,
to get to know each other’s character.

learn.html: The aim of getting to know each other is: bringing their different views closer, agreeing on a shared view of life, planning their married life, and starting a family. When they agree, marriage follows with the consent of both and the blessing (permission) of their parents. Marriage comes after the engagement, and then the civil and the Islamic wedding.

In the Shari‘ah, engagement is recommended, but not obligatory. Its purpose is to confirm the serious intention to marry, and to help the future bride and groom and their families get to know each other better. An engagement is usually sealed with a ring or another gift.

With marriage, the young man and woman begin their own life together. This is celebrated with a wedding – the celebration of the bride moving from the home of her parents (or guardians) into her husband’s home. It is good to announce a marriage publicly, so that as many people as possible know about it.

In Bosnia and Herzegovina, the couple must first confirm their marriage at the state registry office, and then have the Islamic wedding (nikah) before the chief imam, or a person authorised for this, at the majlis or the mosque. The groom offers marriage, and the bride accepts it. In our community, the Imam can explain how a nikah is done here.

learn.title: The mahr
learn.html:
At the nikah the mahr is also agreed – the marriage gift that the bride asks for on the wedding day. There are two kinds of mahr:
• the prompt mahr (mu‘ajjal) – given straight away at the nikah;
• the deferred mahr (mu’ajjal) – given later during the marriage, or if the marriage ends in divorce or the husband dies.
A marriage lasts only if the husband and wife both receive their rights and fulfil their duties.
According to Islamic rules, divorce is not desired, but in justified cases it is allowed.

learn.title: Hadith
learn.html: The Prophet (SAW) said: “Of the things that are allowed, the most hateful to Allah is divorce.” (Abu Dawud)

If, after some time together, a husband and wife cannot live together and there is no hope that things will get better, they are allowed to separate. It is better for them to separate in peace than to make life bitter for each other and for the rest of the family.

practice.title: Questions and tasks
prompts: 💬 What duties do a young man and woman have when they get to know each other? Which steps come before marriage?
💍 What is the mahr, and what kinds of mahr are there? Is divorce allowed in Islam, and in which case?
🕌 Describe how an Islamic nikah is done. Notice everything that is agreed at it. If you have never been to a nikah, ask your muallim to help you attend one.
👵 What special customs of engagement and weddings did Muslims in Bosnia and Herzegovina have, especially in earlier times? Talk with your parents and try to write down and describe each custom.
